events.title: The Logarithm Matrix in Terms of the Tree of 2-Adic Numbers
events.description: Séminaire de géométrie arithmétique The logarithm matrix appears in the arithmetic of elliptic curves, and encodes the growth of arithmetic invariants in towers of number fields. Its definition is a bit involved. One goal of the talk is to present a simpler definition, in terms of 2-adic digits. events.title: A guided hike into quantum machine learning
events.description: Description An introduction to quantum machine learning. With cool pictures! With memes! With food! The lecture will cover a basic introduction to quantum neural networks, quantum kernels, and data encoding techniques, with hands-on sessions for each. More advanced topics such as barren plateaus, expressivity, and "application <-> hardware" pipelines will be brushed over but not covered in detail.
